title: Normalized flat-complex quotient comparison
statement: theorem point_sections_finite_reduction_complex (_hl : IsUnit (l : k)) (e : ∀ (n j : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (_hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n), (pointFiniteReductionBoundedAbove k l E n).ι ⋙ pointFiniteReductionSections k l E n ⋙ pointFiniteReductionModuleTensor l E n j hjn ≅ (pointFiniteReductionBoundedAbove k l E n).ι ⋙ pointFiniteReductionSheafTensor k l E n j hjn ⋙ pointFiniteReductionSections k l E j) : ∀ (n j : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n), ∀ (P : CochainComplex (pointFiniteReductionSheaves k l E n) ℤ) (_hbound : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero (P.X q)) (_hflat : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := pointFiniteReductionRingSheaf k l E n) (P.X q)), ∃ hP : pointFiniteReductionBoundedAbove k l E n (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), ∃ q : (pointFiniteReductionComplexTensor l E n j hjn).obj ((pointFiniteReductionSectionComplex k l E n).obj P) ≅ (pointFiniteReductionSectionComplex k l E j).obj ((pointFiniteReductionSheafComplexTensor k l E n j hjn).obj P), (∀ (a : ℤ) (b c : ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E j)) (x : (pointFiniteSections k (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E n)).obj (P.X a)), q.hom.f a (pointFiniteReductionTensorGenerator l E n j hjn ((pointFiniteReductionSectionComplex k l E n).obj P) a b c x) = (b * c) • pointFiniteReductionSectionGenerator k l E n j hjn (P.X a) x) ∧ (pointFiniteReductionModuleTensor l E n j hjn).map (pointFiniteReductionSectionFactors k l E n P).hom ≫ (pointFiniteReductionModuleCounit l E n j hjn).app ((pointFiniteReductionSectionComplex k l E n).obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map q.hom = (e n j hn hj hjn).hom.app ⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, hP⟩ ≫ (pointFiniteReductionSections k l E j).map (pointFiniteReductionSheafCounit k l E n j hjn P) ≫ (pointFiniteReductionSectionFactors k l E j ((pointFiniteReductionSheafComplexTensor k l E n j hjn).obj P)).hom

proof.text: On a bounded-above termwise flat complex, define the degreewise quotient comparison, prove the pure tensor generator equation and the universal counit square.
